name: Doubling Season
oracle_text:
If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.
blocked_sentences: If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

needs.what: a replace_counters static that applies only to counters put on by an EFFECT, not to counters put on as a COST -- e.g. an `effects_only: true` key on replace_counters, with the loyalty-cost payment in costs.py (`cost.loyalty > 0` -> add_counters) marking its placement as a cost so counter_placement_replacements skips it. Per the Doubling Season ruling, a planeswalker's +N loyalty ability puts N counters (the cost is not doubled), while a planeswalker entering with loyalty, add_counters, proliferate, etc. are doubled.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_counters with counter_multiplier: 2 and affects {controller: you} is the documented shape, but it is read in primitives.add_counters, the single funnel that costs.py also calls to pay a positive loyalty cost; nothing on the call or the static distinguishes cost from effect. So every +1 loyalty activation would become +2 -- a strictly stronger card, and visible in this Atraxa deck, which runs several planeswalkers. (The token sentence is expressible: replace_token_creation with token_multiplier: 2.)
